Application to interstellar cirrus Hennebelle & Pérault · 2000 A&A 359, 1124–1138 Reference listed · scope proposed Oblique magnetic fields and tension alter condensation in slab geometry; transverse motions can align fields or flows and permit compression. Scope in this archive. Compare nonmagnetic, transverse-field, and oblique-field limits using the published self-similar analysis and a small one-dimensional MHD benchmark.
